mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_contexts ( user_id, content, status, source_type, evidence_type, course_id, topic_id, section_id, scope_start, scope_end, self_level, source_message_id, supersedes_context_id, confirmed_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{content}, #{status}, #{sourceType}, #{evidenceType}, #{courseId}, #{topicId}, #{sectionId}, #{scopeStart}, #{scopeEnd}, #{selfLevel}, #{sourceMessageId}, #{supersedesContextId}, #{confirmedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM user_contexts WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND course_id = #{courseId} AND source_type = 'SELF_CHECK' AND status IN ('ACTIVE', 'STALE') ORDER BY updated_at DESC
